name: United Nations
description: Intergovernmental organization promoting international peace, security, and cooperation among 193 member states.

name: World Health Organization
description: UN specialized agency responsible for international public health coordination.

name: International Monetary Fund
description: International financial institution that promotes global monetary cooperation and financial stability.

name: World Bank
description: International financial institution providing loans and grants to developing countries for development projects.

name: World Trade Organization
description: International organization regulating trade between nations through negotiated agreements.

name: Group of Twenty
description: Forum of 20 major economies coordinating global economic and financial policy.

name: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation
description: Regional intergovernmental organization promoting economic and regional integration in South Asia.
